Any Confidential Information (including confidential, competitive, proprietary, or personal information) that is inputted into a third-party generative AI platform could be leaked or disclosed to others, including if Confidential Information is used to train the third parties’ AI model.

Consumer health data is defined to include personal information that is linked or reasonably linkable to a consumer and that identifies a consumer’s past, present, or future physical or mental health status; consumer health data also includes information that is derived or extrapolated from non-health information, such as algorithms and machine learning.
